tags.db.statement: SELECT sku_id, sum(cantidad * precio_unitario) AS ventas FROM ordenes.linea_orden GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY ventas DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT proveedor_id, date_trunc('month', creada_en) AS mes, round(100.0 * avg((entregada_en <= prometida_en)::int), 2) AS otif_pct, round(100.0 * sum(cantidad_recibida) / NULLIF(sum(cantidad_solicitada), 0), 2) AS fill_rate_pct FROM ordenes.orden_compra WHERE proveedor_id = 1 GROUP BY proveedor_id, date_trunc('month', creada_en)
